parts.title: Model Setup and Decoding Strategies
parts.description: Load distilgpt2, sanity-check generation, and implement greedy/temperature/top-k/top-p decoding.

parts.title: SFT Data Pipeline
parts.description: A synthetic instruction dataset plus formatting, tokenization, label masking, padding, batching, splits.

parts.title: SFT Training Loop
parts.description: Shifted next-token loss, AdamW, warmup, grad clipping, accumulation, train/eval steps.

parts.title: LoRA Adapters
parts.description: Low-rank adapters: the LoRA delta, forward, init, freezing, counting, and merge-back.

parts.title: Reward Modeling
parts.description: A synthetic preference dataset and a reward head with pairwise / BCE losses and accuracy.

parts.title: PPO-Based RLHF
parts.description: PPO ingredients: log-probs, KL penalty, returns, GAE, clipped surrogate, value loss, entropy, ppo_loss.

parts.title: Preference Optimization Alternatives
parts.description: Reference-based and reference-free preference losses: DPO, IPO, KTO, ORPO, SimPO.

parts.title: Evaluation and Chat Interface
parts.description: Held-out generation, reward scoring, win rate, token streaming, stop-token handling, and chat.

steps.name: load_distilgpt2_tokenizer
steps.doc: Load the distilgpt2 tokenizer.

steps.name: load_distilgpt2_model
steps.doc: Load the distilgpt2 causal-LM model.

steps.name: set_pad_token_to_eos
steps.doc: GPT-2 has no pad token; reuse the EOS token for padding. Returns the tokenizer.

steps.name: generate_and_decode
steps.doc: Greedy-generate a continuation of ``prompt`` and return the decoded string.

steps.name: greedy_decode
steps.doc: Greedy next-token id(s): argmax over the vocabulary axis.

steps.name: sample_with_temperature
steps.doc: Sample a token id from softmax(logits / temperature).

steps.name: top_k_filter
steps.doc: Keep the top-k logits per row; set the rest to -inf.

steps.name: top_p_filter
steps.doc:
Nucleus filtering: keep the smallest set of tokens whose cumulative
probability reaches ``p``; set the rest to -inf.

steps.name: build_synthetic_instruction_dataset
steps.doc: A deterministic synthetic instruction dataset (simple arithmetic Q&A).

steps.name: format_example
steps.doc: Normalize a raw example to {'prompt', 'response'} strings.

steps.name: apply_template
steps.doc:
Wrap a formatted example in the instruction template. Returns
{'prompt_text', 'full_text'} (full = prompt + response).

steps.name: tokenize_example
steps.doc:
Tokenize the full text; record how many tokens belong to the prompt.
Returns {'input_ids', 'prompt_len'}.

steps.name: build_labels
steps.doc: Labels for causal LM are a copy of the input ids (loss shifts them).

steps.name: mask_prompt_labels
steps.doc: Set the prompt-token labels to ignore_index so loss only covers the response.

steps.name: pad_batch
steps.doc: Right-pad a list of variable-length id sequences to a (batch, maxlen) tensor.

steps.name: make_attention_mask
steps.doc: 1 for real tokens, 0 for padding.

steps.name: collate_lm_batch
steps.doc:
Pad a batch of tokenized examples into input_ids / labels / attention_mask
tensors, masking prompt tokens and padding in the labels.

steps.name: iterate_minibatches
steps.doc: Split ``data`` into minibatches (optionally shuffled). Returns a list of batches.

steps.name: train_val_split
steps.doc: Split into (train, val); the last ``val_fraction`` of examples are validation.

steps.name: shift_logits_and_labels
steps.doc:
Align next-token prediction: drop the last logit and the first label.
(B,T,V),(B,T) -> (B,T-1,V),(B,T-1).

steps.name: cross_entropy_loss
steps.doc: Mean cross-entropy over all positions, ignoring ``ignore_index`` labels.

steps.name: adamw_update
steps.signature: adamw_update(param, grad, m, v, t, lr=0.001, betas=(0.9, 0.999), eps=1e-08, weight_decay=0.01)
steps.doc: One AdamW step (decoupled weight decay) for one tensor. Returns (param, m, v).

steps.name: linear_warmup_schedule
steps.doc: Linearly ramp the LR from 0 to base_lr over warmup_steps, then hold.

steps.name: clip_grad_norm
steps.doc: Scale a list of gradient tensors so their global L2 norm is at most max_norm.

steps.name: accumulate_gradients
steps.doc: Average a list of per-microbatch gradient lists into one gradient list.

steps.name: sft_train_step
steps.doc: One supervised fine-tuning step (shifted next-token loss). Returns the loss value.

steps.name: evaluate_loss
steps.doc: Mean SFT loss over a list of batches (no gradient).

steps.name: lora_delta
steps.doc:
Low-rank update applied to x: (alpha/r) * (x @ A^T) @ B^T.
A is (r, in), B is (out, r); result is (..., out).

steps.name: lora_linear_forward
steps.signature: lora_linear_forward(x, weight, bias, lora_a, lora_b, alpha, r)
steps.doc: Frozen base linear plus the LoRA delta: x@W^T + b + lora_delta(x).

steps.name: init_lora_weights
steps.doc:
LoRA init: A ~ small Gaussian (r, in), B = zeros (out, r) so the initial
delta is exactly zero. Returns (A, B).

steps.name: freeze_base_params
steps.doc: Freeze every parameter of the base model (requires_grad=False). Returns it.

steps.name: count_trainable_params
steps.doc: Total number of parameters with requires_grad=True.

steps.name: merge_lora
steps.doc: Fold the LoRA update into the base weight: W + (alpha/r) * (B @ A). (out,in).

steps.name: build_synthetic_preference_dataset
steps.doc:
Synthetic preferences: each {'prompt','chosen','rejected'} where ``chosen`` is
the better (more helpful) response.

steps.name: format_preference
steps.doc: Build the chosen/rejected full texts from a preference example.

steps.name: reward_head_forward
steps.doc:
Scalar reward per sequence from the last token's hidden state:
h_last @ w + b. hidden_states (B,T,H), weight (H,), bias scalar -> (B,).

steps.name: pairwise_reward_loss
steps.doc: Bradley-Terry preference loss: -log sigmoid(r_chosen - r_rejected), averaged.

steps.name: reward_bce_loss
steps.doc: Pointwise BCE alternative: chosen labeled 1, rejected labeled 0.

steps.name: pairwise_accuracy
steps.doc: Fraction of pairs where the chosen reward exceeds the rejected reward.

steps.name: reward_train_step
steps.doc: One reward-model step: score chosen/rejected, pairwise loss, update. Returns loss.

steps.name: sequence_logprob
steps.doc:
Sum of the log-probs of the realized next tokens. logits (B,T,V),
input_ids (B,T) -> (B,).

steps.name: per_token_kl
steps.doc: Per-token KL estimate between policy and reference: logp - logp_ref.

steps.name: compute_returns
steps.doc: Discounted returns-to-go G_t = sum_{k>=t} gamma^(k-t) r_k. rewards is 1-D (T,).

steps.name: gae_advantages
steps.doc:
Generalized Advantage Estimation. rewards (T,), values (T+1,) with a bootstrap
value at the end. Returns advantages (T,).

steps.name: policy_ratio
steps.doc: Importance ratio exp(logp - logp_old).

steps.name: clipped_surrogate
steps.doc:
PPO clipped surrogate objective (to MAXIMIZE):
mean(min(ratio*A, clip(ratio, 1-eps, 1+eps)*A)).

steps.name: value_function_loss
steps.doc: Critic loss: 0.5 * mean((values - returns)^2).

steps.name: entropy_bonus
steps.doc: Mean entropy of the policy distribution (encourages exploration).

steps.name: ppo_loss
steps.doc: Total PPO loss to MINIMIZE: -surrogate + vf_coef*value_loss - ent_coef*entropy.

steps.name: kl_penalized_reward
steps.doc: Shape the reward with a per-token KL-to-reference penalty.

steps.name: batch_sequence_logprob
steps.doc: Run the model and return the per-sequence log-prob of ``input_ids`` (B,).
